transcription: The concentrations are printed as TEXT inside the figure's raster at two decimal
places, so this table is exact to the paper's own precision and carries no
digitisation error. A blank cell means no number was printed beside that street; the
unpublished: The paper gives no street length, width or building height, no emission rate, no
friction velocity, no boundary-layer height, no Monin-Obukhov length and no
background concentration; the Zenodo package (10.5281/zenodo.6167477) is the
577-street Paris case, and no 12-street input file exists anywhere in the MUNICH git
history. ABSOLUTE concentrations therefore cannot be reproduced -- only ratios and
wind_convention: The paper's directions are meteorological -- the direction the wind comes FROM,
degrees clockwise from north. theta_w_rad is the same wind in this application's
convention: the direction it blows TOWARDS, radians counter-clockwise from east,

comment: The best uniform geometry over a 150-point grid of H in {5, 8, 12, 20, 30} m, W/H in
{0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4} and L/H in {2, 5, 10, 20, 40, 80}, scored on the five printed
ratios of panel (a). It is NOT the paper's geometry, which is unpublished; it is the
assumption this comparison is made under, and it is stated here so the residual
